research_extensions.HOTT-QUOTATION-BRIDGE-001: Separates Agda host TC, MetaRocq syntax quotation and guarded/clocked temporal later; 6 fixed sources, 12 artifacts, 66 anchors and 10 exact-replay probes establish a conditional fixed-clock-force collapse while the actual tick/clock and host boundaries remain enforced. Verdict: guarded force-erasure boundary with defense, HoTT bug not established.
research_extensions.TICK-IRRELEVANCE-OPERATIONAL-GAP-001: Runs the exact historical forcing-ticks checker and compares diamond judgemental unfolding with ordinary-tick Path unfolding. An internal Path-respecting Bool observer would derive true = false, but actual CCTT keeps ticks in special syntax, operation discrimination in the meta reducer and pfix/tirr/force-delay at Path equality. 3 source systems, 18 pinned artifacts, 4 source trees, 54 anchors, a complete three-edge equality search and 9 exact-replay probes. Verdict: representation boundary; no natural promotion in the frozen consumers; HoTT bug not established.
research_extensions.REFLECTED-TICK-REDUCTION-OBSERVER-001: Separates host reflection syntax observation from object-level Path-respecting observation and calibrates manually termination-asserted recursion. Revision 5 replaces the live whole-project formal-tree dependency with a hash-pinned exhaustive 99-file/50-source zero-annotation snapshot, preserving the historical denominator without invalidation from later unrelated formal packages. Revisions 1-4 and two path/module qualification failures remain preserved. Ten frozen probes and independent exact replay retain the implementation-level completion boundary; reality-relative nonreality and a Goedel instance are not established.
research_extensions.COQ-HOTT-REFLECTIVE-TYPECLASS-RECURSION-: Qualifies Coq-HoTT at commit cc618472 under Rocq 9.0.1 and compares default, registered, bounded-depth, known-equivalence and generic recursive typeclass search. Eight probes replay exactly. Verdict: community HoTT automation recursion boundary; no object-language provability predicate, theory paradox or HoTT-specific cause.
research_extensions.CUBICAL-MACHINE-HALTING-001: A deterministic two-counter object machine has a total step semantics. Cubical Agda proves one fixed program halts, one fixed program diverges at every finite step, and the latter does not halt. This reaches R1 certified concrete divergence; R2 universal undecidability and reality correspondence remain open.
research_extensions.CUBICAL-GODEL-PROOF-CHECKER-001: Six Cubical Agda proof packages construct a small Hilbert object language, total raw-proof checker, postfix serialization, self-delimiting formula/proof bits, natural-number proof code, total natural-code checker and an exhaustive deterministic proof/refutation PartBool classifier. Twenty-four claims have canonical runs and frozen matrix rows. The calculus now inhabits the synthetic FormalSystem interface; universality, strong representability and exact HoTT-calculus instantiation remain open.
research_extensions.CUBICAL-SYNTHETIC-INCOMPLETENESS-001: A source-aligned Cubical Agda adaptation of Kirst-Peters proves that, under an explicit universal step-indexed partial-function hypothesis, every self-return separator diverges at a constructed index; a strongly separating formal system therefore has an independent sentence, and every extension inherits one. Five claims are machine-proved with exact replay. Universality and strong separation remain uninstantiated for HoTT; the proof/refutation classifier is now instantiated only for the small K/S/MP calculus.
research_extensions.COQ-SYNTHETIC-INCOMPLETENESS-REPLAY-001: Pins uds-psl/coq-synthetic-incompleteness at cd7d849, builds fol_incompleteness.vo from two independent clean worktrees under Coq 8.15.2, obtains byte-identical logs and 1,284 stable kernel artifacts, and exactly reruns a qualification module for five key constants. The theorem signatures retain explicit universality, CTQ, Peirce, Q-extension, enumerability and consistency premises. This calibrates the local Cubical theorem shape; it does not instantiate HoTT or reality correspondence.
research_extensions.NONTERMINATION-OVERVIEW-COMPLETENESS-AUD: Separates workflow completeness, frozen-grammar enumeration completeness, frozen-corpus coverage, candidate-reduction coverage, exact-HoTT mechanism closure and global discovery completeness. Verdict: the research protocol is structurally complete; PF-CUBICAL-CANDIDATE-COVERAGE-001 machine-proves one exact bounded grammar and task-preserving reduction slice; no reduction theorem covers all relevant HoTT candidates, no exact HoTT/reality bridge is closed, and a total global discovery decider is not the target.
research_extensions.CUBICAL-CANDIDATE-COVERAGE-001: For every bound n, Cubical Agda proves that allRaw n covers the exact Raw n never/now/later grammar. Normalization into the canonical R041 Delay Bool representation preserves convergence, every deadline observation, horizon and expected observation; every reduced candidate appears in canonicalSpace. Five claims replay exactly. This establishes one COMP-2 slice, not full candidate-class COMP-4, HoTT essentiality or reality correspondence.
